description:
Synopsis: Federal Law Enforcement Training Center intends to award a firm fixed price single source award. This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. No solicitation document will be posted.
Noncompetitive Contract Action: IAW FAR Part 12.102(a)
Source: RELX INC
Reason: Required material to support training classes.
Scope of Work: Immigration Law Handbooks and Immigration Pocket Field Guide for training classes.
PSC: 7690 Miscellaneous Printed Matter
NAICS: 323117 Books Printing
Description: 900EA Immigration Law Handbook

Set-Aside Requirement – None
Delivery Destination:
FLETC
1131 CHAPEL CROSSING ROAD
BUILDING 217
BRUNSWICK, GA, 31524
The Government will award a firm fixed price (FFP) contract
Shipping must be free on board (FOB) destination CON US (Continental U.S.), which means that the seller must
deliver the goods on its conveyance at the destination specified by the buyer, and the seller is responsible for the
cost of shipping and risk of loss prior to actual delivery at the specified destination.
Item Condition: New Equipment ONLY; No remanufactured or "gray market" items. All items must be covered by the manufacturer's
warranty.
All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the agency.
